spots.name: Shore
spots.blurb: Warm sand, tiny ripples and very polite fish.

spots.name: Reef
spots.blurb: Coral colours and a busy little crowd.

spots.name: Kelp Forest
spots.blurb: Tall green ribbons swaying in cool water.

spots.name: Deep Sea
spots.blurb: Blue-black water where the big shapes drift by.

spots.name: Abyss
spots.blurb: Hushed and starlit, far below the last sunbeam.

rods.name: Driftwood Rod
rods.blurb: A smooth stick and a string. Free, and it tries its best.

rods.name: Reedline Rod
rods.blurb: Light and springy. The line stays calm a little longer.

rods.name: Pearlwhip Rod
rods.blurb: A pearl-wrapped grip that fish seem to admire.

rods.name: Tidecaller Rod
rods.blurb: Hums softly whenever the tide is turning.

rods.name: Starweave Rod
rods.blurb: Spun from night sky. Patient, steady and a little magic.

baits.name: Glow Worm
baits.blurb: A cheerful little glow. Uncommon fish adore it.

baits.name: Silver Lure
baits.blurb: One flash of silver that rare fish cannot ignore.

baits.name: Tide Crumbs
baits.blurb: A sprinkle of treats for the spot's own favourites.
